# Eazy Review

> Mobile-first sneaker discovery and reviews built with Expo, React Native,
> TypeScript and Supabase. Public browsing; login to rate. Eazy Score,
> Community Score and My Rating are distinct product concepts.

This is a repository reading map in the llms.txt convention, not a new policy
or an executable installer. Resolve relative links from the repository root
at the same checkout/ref. Read AGENTS.md first and only the documents needed
for the user's task. package.json and package-lock.json own dependency versions.
Do not assume this file is automatically loaded by an agent or served by the app.

Use the user's request and current Git/PR state. A skill, MCP registration or
board status does not grant action authority. Keep secrets local. Production
database access and agent-executed account deletion are forbidden. Review
executable inputs before host execution; follow SECURITY for isolation when
trust is not established. Publication, hosted changes and acceptance follow
the canonical delivery/tool policies linked below.

## Start here

- [Agent entrypoint](AGENTS.md): Shared instructions and routing to affected contracts.
- [Project README](README.md): Product overview, evidence and quick start.
- [Host and agent setup](docs/HOST_SETUP.md): New workstation, agent discovery, service connections, verification and migration.
- [Development guide](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md): Local backend, web/native builds, device networking and recovery setup.
- [Package manifest](package.json): Dependencies, runtime/package-manager requirements and exact scripts.

## Agent infrastructure and boundaries

- [Agent workflow](docs/AGENT_WORKFLOW.md): Validation selection, delegation, review and failure handling.
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): Install trust, secrets, environment boundaries and vulnerability reporting.
- [External tools](docs/MCP_WORKFLOW.md): Optional local MCP setup, ego-browser, Otty and effect-based authorization.
- [Documentation and delivery](docs/DOCUMENTATION_POLICY.md): Evidence, PR lifecycle, human acceptance and exact Project board approvals.
- [Project item lookup](docs/DOCUMENTATION_POLICY.md#github-project-4-mirror): Resolve a stable ER ID or original Alias, then read its Source and relevant ledger entry.
- [Skill manifest](skills/manifest.json): Five project skills; canonical procedures are under skills/, generated discovery wrappers are committed.
- [Infrastructure graph](config/agent-infrastructure.json): Document ownership and dependencies; not credentials or MCP connection configuration.

## Product and implementation

- [Task ledger](docs/TASKS.md): Canonical work status; inspect only relevant entries and verify live delivery state.
